label_correction.reason: The single label was overly broad. It read as a verdict on extraction accuracy, which the evidence contradicts: conditional precision is 0.9868 combined and 0.9860 held out. The frozen gate failed on verified COVERAGE, not on precision. The gate itself, its thresholds and its FAILED outcome are unchanged.

later_xbrl_role: audit reference only; it never selected, replaced or altered an Exhibit value and never entered a model feature

binding_finding.name: fiscal_year_end_quarter_has_no_three_month_10q_reference
binding_finding.detail: A fiscal-year-end quarter's EPS is never restated as a discrete three-month fact in a subsequent 10-Q, because the next periodic report is the 10-K, which carries the annual figure. Those events can therefore never be validated or contradicted under the frozen reference definition.
binding_finding.implication: reference_coverage >= 0.80 is arithmetically unreachable for this universe under the frozen reference definition, independent of parser quality. The gate was not loosened.

general_structural_defects_fixed: statement-title (caption) test was vetoed by prose preceding the statement; only text from the last statement title onward is now considered
the statement title may sit in the table's own leading header rows rather than in preceding text
guidance and outlook columns dated after the release were eligible as the current quarter; a reported quarter cannot end after the release that reports it
the audit reference collapsed to the earliest-filed fact, which is usually the 8-K's own fact and was then discarded by the filed-after-release test
a periodic report filed on the same calendar day as the 8-K under a different accession is still filed after the release

unchanged_ticker_value_stability.note: AMAT dropped 2 events by becoming more conservative and AMD gained 1; no previously extracted value was altered.

recommendation: Stop hand-building this parser. Reliable structured data would be required to test this hypothesis. Extraction recall rose from 123 to 216 and precision stayed at 0.9868 combined and 0.9860 held out, yet the coverage gates remain unreachable because roughly a fifth of all earnings events are fiscal-year-end quarters that cannot be validated against a subsequent 10-Q at all. No further hand-built parser iteration is recommended for this solo project.

interpretation.frozen_study_status: The frozen study stopped correctly at the extraction quality gate and remains UNTESTED. No hypothesis about semiconductor EPS-price absorption was evaluated, supported or refuted.
interpretation.conditional_precision_scope: High conditional precision (0.9868 combined, 0.9860 held out) applies ONLY to the subset of extractions for which the selected later-10-Q audit reference exists. It is precision conditional on referenceability, not overall extraction accuracy.
interpretation.unreferenced_fy_end_scope_note: 47 of 216 extractions are fiscal-year-end quarters lacking the selected later-10-Q reference. Their accuracy is neither confirmed nor refuted by the conditional-precision figure; they are unverified, not verified-wrong.
interpretation.failure_composition: The failure combines (a) inadequate verified coverage - reference_coverage 0.7037 and usable_event_coverage 0.2742 against required 0.80 and 0.60 - with (b) a reference design that structurally cannot label many fiscal-year-end quarters, capping attainable reference_coverage at 1 - 47/216 = 0.7824, below the frozen 0.80 gate.
interpretation.returns_inspected_note: No return was inspected. No price reaction, strategy or outcome was read or computed at any point in either attempt or in this correction pass.
